title: COMMAND YOUR SUNDAY FOR GOOD NEWS ALERT
text: Let me tell you a story before anything else this morning. There was a man sitting in a well, not by choice. His brothers, his own blood, stripped him naked, threw him in, and walked away to eat lunch while he screamed for help. His name was Joseph. And in that moment, if you had asked him who the right people in his life were, he would not have had an answer because everyone he trusted had [music] turned against him. Everyone he loved had thrown him away. He was alone, naked in a pit with no phone, no contacts, no network, no LinkedIn, no connections, nothing. But God But God was doing something Joseph could not see. God was positioning a caravan of Ishmaelite merchants on a trade route that happened to pass by that exact well at that exact moment. Genesis chapter 37, verses 25 to 28. Joseph did not know those merchants. Those merchants did not know Joseph. There was no prior relationship, no mutual friend, no introduction. But God [music] connected them because the right people do not always come through your existing network. Sometimes the right people are strangers that God converts into destiny carriers without your involvement. And that caravan, those strangers, carried Joseph all the way to Egypt where he met Potiphar, where he met the butler, where he met Pharaoh. Each one a right person positioned at the right time, in the right place, for the right purpose. Joseph did not find any of them, they found him. Or more accurately, God found them for him. That is what is about to happen to you today. The right people are going to find you, not because of your networking skills, not because of your social media presence, not because of your charm or charisma or credentials, because G.O.D. is orchestrating a divine intersection. He is moving people you have never met toward a convergence point with your life. And by the time this day is over, at least one connection will have been made that will alter the trajectory of your future. But you have to be in position, you have to be spiritually receptive, you have to be prayerfully prepared. And that is exactly what we are doing in this service. We are preparing the landing strip for divine connections. We are clearing the runway for the right people to touch down in your life. Now, share this message immediately, without hesitation. Because here is a paradox of the kingdom. Sometimes you are the right person for someone else. Sometimes the divine connection God is orchestrating is not just for you, it is through you. When you share this message, you might be the bridge that connects someone to their destiny helper. You might be the link that joins two lives that were meant to intersect. Share it. Be the connection. Be the link. Be the bridge. And in being the bridge for others, God will build bridges for you. Now, let us worship. And I want this worship to be a signal. In the spirit realm, worship functions as a homing beacon, like a lighthouse that guides ships to shore, like a radio tower that broadcasts a frequency. Your worship today is sending out a signal, a spiritual GPS coordinate that tells the right people where to find you. The louder you worship, the stronger the signal. The deeper you go, the wider the broadcast. So, do not whisper. Do not mumble. Worship. Sing with me. You are good. You are good. Oh, oh. You are good. All you do is good. All you do is good. All you do is good. You are good. Psalm 119:68, "Thou art good and doest good." He's good in his nature and good in his actions. His goodness is not selective. His goodness is not partial. His goodness is comprehensive. It touches every area. It reaches every dimension. And one of the ways his goodness manifests is by sending the right people into your life at the right time. You are good. All you do is good. Every person he has ever sent into your life that blessed you, that was his goodness. [music] Every stranger who helped you when you had no claim on their help, that was his goodness. Every divine appointment that changed your trajectory, that was his goodness. He's good and he's doing good today, right now in this service by preparing connections that will bless your life in ways you cannot currently imagine. You are good. You are good and all you do is good. Let worship evolve now. Let it deepen. I give myself away. >> [music] >> I give myself away so you can use me. I give myself away. I give myself away so you can use me. Here I am. Here I am. Use me. Here I am. Here I am. Use me. >> [music] >> That is the posture of someone who is ready for divine connections, open, available, surrendered. Not clutching your agenda, not gripping your plans, released, saying to God, "Use me." Position me. Connect me. Send who you want to send, take me where you want to take me. I am yours. My schedule is yours. My phone is yours. My path is yours. Direct my steps today toward the people who carry my next season. I give myself away so you can use me. Take my life and let it be consecrated, Lord, to thee. Take my moments and my days. Let them flow in ceaseless praise. Take my hands and let them move at the impulse of thy love. Take my feet and let them be swift and beautiful for thee. Consecration, complete surrender, every body part offered to God, hands that he can use to shake the right hand today, feet that he can direct to the right location today, a mouth that he can open to say the right words to the right person today, a heart that he can soften to receive whoever he sends. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Father, we worship you as the God of connections, the God who connected Abraham with Melchizedek, the God who connected Ruth with Boaz, the God who connected David with Jonathan, the God who connected Elisha with the widow, the God who connected Paul with Timothy. Every significant relationship in scripture was orchestrated by your hand, and we trust that same hand to orchestrate our connections today. We worship you, we honor you, we surrender to your divine networking. Hallelujah. Bring the worship to a gentle close. Let the atmosphere remain thick. Let the glory remain heavy, and let your spirit remain wide open. Because the teaching that is about to come is going to give you the theological framework to understand how God connects people and how to position yourself to receive the connections he's sending. Now, sit, listen, receive. Go with me to Proverbs chapter 18, verse 16. A man's gift maketh room for him and bringeth him before great men. Read that slowly. A man's gift, his talent, his skill, his anointing, his contribution maketh room for him. It creates space. It opens doors. It carves out a seat at a table that [music] was previously full, and it bringeth him before great men. Not average men, not mediocre men, great men. Men of influence, men of resource, men of authority. Men of destiny. Your gift is a magnet for the right people. When you operate in your God-given gift, you emit a frequency that attracts people who are meant to connect with you. A singer singing attracts producers. An entrepreneur building attracts investors. A writer writing attracts publishers. A preacher preaching attracts platforms. The gift does the attracting. You just have to operate in it. But, here is where many people miss it. They stop operating in their gift because the right people have not shown up yet. They say, "I will start using my gift when I get the right opportunity. I will launch my business when I find the right investor. I will sing publicly when I get the right producer." That is backward. The gift comes first. The people come second. Operate in the gift, and the right people will find you. The gift is the signal, the people are the response. Now, go with me to a second scripture. Genesis chapter 24:27. This is the story of Abraham's servant who was sent to find a wife for Isaac. And when he arrived at the well and met Rebecca, he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth. I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master's brethren. I being in the way, the Lord led me." While I was walking, while I was moving, while I was on the path, while I was in motion, the Lord guided my steps to the exact right person at the exact right moment. This is critical. The right people find you when you are in the way, not sitting at home doing nothing, not lying in bed scrolling through social media, not waiting passively for a knock on the door. In the way, in motion, in activity, in obedience, in the process of living your life, following your calling, operating in your gift, walking in your purpose, the servant was walking, Ruth was gleaning, David was tending sheep, Peter was fishing, they were all in the way actively engaged in something when the divine connection happened. God does not connect people who are idle. He connects people who are in motion. So, move, start, act, do something, go somewhere, build something, create something. And while you are in the way, the Lord will lead the right people directly to you. One more revelation, and this one is going to set the stage for the most powerful prayer you have prayed about connections. Go with me to Psalm 75:6-7. For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south, but God is the judge. He putted down one and setted up another. Promotion does not come from a geographical direction. It does not come from the east or the west or the south. Interestingly, the north is not mentioned because in Hebrew cosmology, the north was God's direction, the seat of divine authority. [music] Promotion comes from G O D. He puts down one and sets up another. And how does God promote through people? God does not send an angel with a promotion letter. He sends a [music] person, a boss who notices you, a client who recommends you, a stranger who sponsors you, a friend who introduces you, a mentor who elevates you. Promotion comes from God, but it is delivered through the right people. So, when we pray for the right people to find us, we're actually praying for promotion, for elevation, for advancement, for breakthrough, because every right person carries a piece of your next level. They carry a door, they carry a key, they carry a resource, they carry an introduction, they carry a word, they carry an opportunity. And when they find you, when the divine connection is made, something in your life shifts, something elevates, something advances. I prophesy the right people are being dispatched to your coordinates right now. Heaven has released them. Angels are guiding them. The Holy Spirit is directing their steps. And before this day is over, at least one divine connection will be activated, one conversation that changes everything, one meeting that opens a new chapter, one encounter that rewrites your story. Somebody declare, the right people will find me today. Say it with more authority, the right people will find me today. Now, let us pray. Stand up. This is not casual prayer. This is strategic, targeted, precision-guided warfare prayer. We're not just praying into the air. We're praying into specific outcomes. Specific connections, specific people, specific encounters. And by the authority of the name of Jesus Christ, heaven is about to move on your behalf. Father, in the mighty, matchless, magnificent name of Jesus Christ, the name that commands angels, the name that silences demons, the name that opens doors no man can shut, we approach your throne with boldness. Hebrews chapter 4 verse 16. Not with timidity, not with uncertainty, with boldness because we are children approaching a father, heirs approaching a king, covenant partners approaching the God who keeps his word. And we pray with specificity. Lord, we're not praying vague prayers today. We're praying targeted prayers. We're calling out the right people by function even though we do not yet know their names. We are summoning divine connections from the four corners of the earth. We are activating encounters that have been scheduled in your calendar since before the foundation of the world. Now, open your mouth and decree. I decree the right people will find me today, not the wrong people disguised as right, not counterfeit connections dressed in covenant clothing, the right people. People who carry the anointing for my next level, people who hold the keys to doors I have been standing outside, people who have the resources my vision requires, people who have the wisdom my journey needs. People who have the authority to position me where I belong, the right people. And they will find me today. I decree every wrong person in my life is being identified and removed. Not violently, not dramatically, but decisively. The same God who sends right people removes wrong ones. And I trust his editing as much as I trust his connecting. If there is someone in my circle who is a spy for the enemy, a Judas disguised as a disciple, a Delilah pretending to be a helpmate, expose them, Lord. Remove them. Replace them with genuine God-sent, heaven-approved connections. Psalm 1 verse 1. Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. Bless me, Lord, by removing ungodly counsel from my circle. Bless me by separating me from sinners who masquerade as friends. Bless me by lifting me from the seat of the scornful. And then fill those vacated seats with the right people. People of faith, people of vision, people of integrity, people of destiny. Something is shifting. I can feel the atmosphere moving. Like tectonic plates beneath the surface of your life are repositioning. People who were far are being brought near. People who were distant are being drawn close. People who did not know your name this morning are going to know it by tonight. Something is moving in the spirit realm. Connections are being formed. Bridges are being built. Pathways are being cleared. Now, let me pray specifically for destiny connections. The connections that are directly linked to your life's purpose. Every person was created for an assignment and every assignment requires a team. Moses needed Aaron. David needed Jonathan. Elijah needed Elisha. Paul needed Barnabas. Jesus needed the 12. No one fulfills destiny alone. Ecclesiastes chapter 4 verse 9, "Two are better than one because they have a good reward for their labor." Father, assemble the team. Bring the Aaron to every Moses in this service. Send the Jonathan to every David under the sound of my voice. Deploy the Elisha for every Elijah who is tired and ready to give up. Connect the Barnabas with every Paul who needs encouragement to launch into ministry. Assemble the destiny team. I decree that every person who is supposed to be on your team, your business partner, your ministry associate, your creative collaborator, your strategic adviser, your financial backer, your prayer partner, is being directed to your location right now. Some of them will show up physically, some will reach [music] out digitally, some will be introduced through a mutual connection, but they are all on their way. By the end of this week, your team will look different. [music] Your circle will feel different. Your network will operate differently because God is adding the right players to your squad. Now, family deliverance and connections because some of you come from families where good connections are rare. Your family is isolated, disconnected. Your parents never had influential friends. Your siblings never had powerful networks. And that pattern of disconnection has been passed down to you. But that generational pattern ends [music] today. Galatians chapter 3 verse 13, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." Every generational curse of disconnection broken. Every ancestral pattern of isolation shattered. Every family history of missing the right people overwritten by the blood of Jesus. From today, your family is a connected family. Your children will know the right people. Your grandchildren will sit at tables of influence. Your lineage will be marked by strategic destiny shaping God ordained relationships. I speak to every evil altar that has been working against divine connections in your family. Altars that have been offered sacrifices to ensure your bloodline remains isolated and disconnected from help us born. Every covenant that dedicated your family to loneliness and lack of support canceled by the blood. Every cause spoken by jealous relatives to ensure no one in your family ever meets the right person reversed by the name of Jesus. Now, marriage connections because for some of you, the right person you need most urgently is a spouse. Ruth chapter 2:3, and she went and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers, and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging on to Boaz. Ruth was gleaning, walking, in motion, in the way, and her steps happened to take her to Boaz's field, but it was not happenstance. It was divine choreography. God directed her feet to the exact field where her destiny husband was standing. I pray for everyone who is single and believing God for a spouse. Father, choreograph their steps, direct their feet to the right field, lead them to the place where their Boaz is standing, where their Ruth is gleaning. Let the intersection happen naturally, but be orchestrated supernaturally. Let it look like coincidence, but be planned by heaven. Every spirit of marital delay, your tenure is over. Every spirit husband or spirit wife that has been occupying the marital space, you are evicted by fire. Every monitoring spirit that has been scaring away potential spouses blinded and removed. Every witchcraft web that has been tangling the love lives of anyone in this service, torn [music] apart by the blood of Jesus. For those already married, I pray that the right people find your marriage, the right counselors, the right mentors, the right couple friends who model what a healthy marriage looks like. The right spiritual covering that protects your home. God is not just sending right people for you individually. He's sending right people for your marriage. Financial connections now, because wealth is transferred through people. Money does not fall from the sky. It flows through relationships. Contracts come through connections. Investments come through networks. Opportunities come through introductions. Your financial breakthrough is wrapped inside a person and that person is being sent to you today. Proverbs chapter 13:22, "The wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just." >> [music] >> The wealth is laid up. It is stored. It is waiting. It is ready for transfer and the transfer mechanism is a person. An employer who hires you, a client who contracts you, an investor who backs you, a customer who patronizes you, a benefactor who sponsors you. These are the people who carry your financial breakthrough and they are being sent to you now. Father, release financial connectors into the lives of your people. Send the person who has the contract. Send the person who has the investment. Send the person who has the job offer. Send the person who has the business idea that needs their skill. Send the person who has the property that needs their management. Send the person who carries the provision. I decree financial strangers are becoming financial friends today. People who do not owe you anything are going to give you something. People who have no obligation to help are going to extend a hand. People who were not in your budget are going to fund your vision because God moves hearts. Proverbs chapter 21 verse 1. And the hearts he is moving today carry wealth. I am sensing something prophetically. There is someone in this service who is a graphic designer or a web developer or someone in the creative industry. >> [music] >> You have been doing freelance work and struggling to find consistent clients. The spirit of God is saying a person is coming to you this week. They run a company that needs exactly your skill set. And they are not looking for a one-time project. They are looking for a long-term partnership, a retainer, consistent income, monthly provision, the kind of arrangement you have been praying for. Do not underprice yourself. Quote what you are worth because [music] this person has the budget and God has already told your heart to say yes. Receive it. There is also someone who has been praying for a mentor. You feel directionless, uncovered, unguided. You see other people thriving under mentorship and you wonder, "Where is my mentor?" The spirit of God is saying, "Your mentor is not going to come from where you expect. It is not going to be the famous pastor. It is not going to be the popular influencer. It is going to be someone quiet. Someone who does not have a million followers but has a million hours of wisdom. Someone who will not post about mentoring you but will call you at midnight to pray for you. They are coming and when they arrive you will feel a peace in your spirit that confirms this is the one. Receive it. Hallelujah. Now, health and healing connections >> [music] >> because sometimes the right person God sends is a doctor, a specialist, a therapist, a healer, someone who has the knowledge, the skill and the anointing to diagnose what others missed and treat what others could not. Second Kings chapter 5 verses 2 to 3. Naaman was a great military commander but he had leprosy and the person God used to connect him to his healing was a slave girl. A young Israelite captive who served Naaman's wife. She said, "Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria for he would recover him of his leprosy." A slave girl connected a general to a prophet [music] and the general was healed. Your healing connection might come from the most unlikely source. It might be a casual conversation with a stranger who mentions a doctor you have never heard of. It might be a social media post that leads you to a specialist in another city. It might [music] be a friend who says, "Have you tried this treatment?" The right medical connection is part of the right people package and God is sending it. Father, connect every sick person in this service with the right medical professional, the right doctor who will not just prescribe medication but will find the root cause. The right specialist who has treated this exact condition successfully, the right therapist who understands the intersection of spirit and soul. Send them the right person for their healing journey. But beyond natural healing connections, I release supernatural healing right now. >> [music] >> Because the greatest healer is not a doctor. The greatest physician is not in a hospital. The greatest specialist is Jesus Christ, and he's in this service. I speak to everybody in this room and under the sound of my voice, be healed. Cancer, your connection to this body is severed. Tumors, your attachment to this organ is dissolved. Diabetes, your grip on this system is broken. Heart disease, your occupation of this body is terminated. Kidney failure function is being restored. Liver disease regeneration is beginning. Chronic pain, your residency permit is revoked. You are an illegal tenant in a body owned by the Holy Ghost. 1 Corinthians chapter 6 verse 19. And you are being evicted. Isaiah chapter 53 verse 5. With his stripes, we are healed. By stripes that were administered 2,000 years ago, by wounds that were inflicted on a Friday afternoon at a place called Calvary, by blood that was shed once and never needs to be shed again. Healed, present tense, active tense, right now tense. Now, covenants, curses, and evil altars. We must deal with the spiritual structures that repel right people from your life because there are covenants that create a spiritual repellent around certain people. The right people approach, but something pushes them away. The right connections are formed, but something dissolves them. The right doors open, but something slams them shut. The source is often a covenant. [music] An ancestral agreement that said, "This family will never have helpers. This bloodline will never have supporters. This lineage will walk alone." Or a curse, a spoken word of isolation that said no one will stand by you, everyone will leave you, you will die alone and forgotten. Or an altar, a shrine where sacrifices are offered specifically to isolate you from your destiny helpers, to create an invisible force field that repels every good connection. But Colossians chapter 2 verse 14, blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. Every ordinance, every written decree in the spirit realm that says you must walk alone, every covenant document that mandates your isolation, nailed to the cross, blotted out, taken out of the way. In the name of Jesus, I destroy every covenant of isolation over your life. Every ancestral agreement with spirits of loneliness cancelled. Every generational pact that programmed your family for disconnection annulled. Every ritual that was performed to ensure you never have genuine support neutralized. I reverse every cause of relational failure, every spoken word that said you would always be alone reversed. Every prophecy of isolation uttered over your life overturned. Every declaration that friends would abandon you and helpers would vanish nullified. You are not cursed to be alone, you are blessed to be connected. Psalm 68 verse 6, God setteth the solitary in families. God places the lonely among people. God connects the disconnected. God networks the isolated. That is his nature, that is his work, and he's doing it for you today. Every evil altar that has been creating a repellent field around your life, I command the fire of God to consume it. Every altar in your village, every altar in your bloodline, every altar in the spirit realm that has your picture and your name and is being used to push away destiny help us fire. Absolute total consuming fire. The fire of Elijah that consumed the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, the dust, and even the water. First Kings chapter 18 verse 38. That fire is falling on every altar that repels right people from your life. Burn it down. Toreversha londai prashkovabundai mekoriltundai sekeliyundai yorivalemashundai lorikomekelundai torivalepreshkai sekelibundai prashkovarundai toreversha altundai mekorilborashundai yorivalemashkai sekeliyundai Father restore the connections that should have been made years ago. Compress time, accelerate introductions, fast track relationships. Let them meet in 1 month the people they should have met over 10 years. Let them build in one conversation the trust that usually takes 10 meetings. Supernatural acceleration in the realm of divine connections. I speak to every virtue that was drained during the isolation years. The confidence to network restored. The courage to introduce yourself restored. The charisma that draws people restored. The social grace that makes relationships smooth restored. The ability to discern right people from wrong people sharpened. You are not going to connect with everyone. You are going to connect with the right ones. Your discernment is being upgraded so that you can identify divine connections on sight. Divine preservation. Because as the right people begin to find you, [music] the enemy will try to destroy the connections through premature conflict, misunderstanding, or tragedy. Psalm 121:7, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul." Father, preserve every connection that is formed today. >> [music] >> Protect it from misunderstanding, shield it from jealousy, guard it from manipulation. Let every right relationship that begins today be built on a foundation that cannot be shaken. Let it grow, let it deepen, let it multiply, and let no weapon formed against it prosper. Isaiah chapter 54:17. I also pray for physical preservation. Keep them alive. Keep them safe. Keep them healthy. So that they can enjoy the relationships God is sending. So that they can benefit from the connections being made. So that they can participate in the future these relationships will create. No premature death. No sudden sickness. No unexpected accident. Preserve for connection. Preserve for relationship. Preserve for destiny. >> [music] >> Now, praise. This is the praise of someone who knows that their phone is about to ring with an introduction they did not arrange. The praise of someone who knows that tomorrow they will meet someone who changes everything. The praise of someone who knows that the God who connected Joseph with Pharaoh and Ruth with Boaz and David with Jonathan is the same God connecting them today. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, the communion of the Holy Spirit, the connections of heaven, the favor of the Almighty be with you now, tomorrow, this week, this month, this year, and for the rest of your divinely connected, strategically positioned, purposefully network life. In Jesus mighty, connecting, networking, positioning, favoring, assembling, orchestrating, destiny linking name we have prayed. Amen and amen and amen.
